title: .respawnpack/runtime/rollover/<host>-<conversationId>/<handoffId>.json — the v0.3 rollover handoff
description: Written once and never rewritten by core/state/handoff.js, then verified by a sibling <handoffId>.verified.json receipt and claimed exactly once through a <handoffId>.consumed.json receipt created with `wx`. ⛔ THE DOCUMENT IS IMMUTABLE ON PURPOSE: schemaVersion 1.0.0 (precompact-handoff) was rewritten twice after it was written — once to stamp readBackVerified, once to stamp consumedAt — so the bytes that were verified were never the bytes that were injected and the file's own digest could prove nothing. GITIGNORED, machine-local, and NOT registered in schemas/registry.json: registration happens in W2 alongside the first real writer, because a declared family with no shipped writer is a schema pointing at nothing.

identity.description: The conversation this handoff belongs to. A host id is unique only WITHIN its host, and the hosts disagree on the field name, so both travel.

conversationIdField.description: Which field of the host payload the id was read from — session_id (Claude), threadId (Codex app server), sessionId (Pi). A bare id cannot say where it came from.

contextCycleId.description: host:conversationId:cycleIndex:cycleNonce. REQUIRED: a handoff not bound to a cycle can be re-injected into any of them.

exactNextAction.description: Null is legal and meaningful — a migrated v1 record recorded none, and manufacturing one would be reconstructing a conclusion from memory.

uncommittedTruncated.description: Truncation is REPORTED, never silent — a capped list that does not say it was capped reads as complete.

verificationEvidence.description: What this session actually proved, as records rather than as claims. An empty array is a real answer.

candidateMemories.description: IDS ONLY. A candidate memory is an unverified lead; inlining its text here would deliver it into the next cycle looking exactly like the verified facts beside it.

raw.description: The originating document, VERBATIM, when this handoff was migrated. Deliberately unconstrained: it is another schema's artifact and summarising it would delete the only copy of what that session recorded.
